entities.title: Hook policy, init and report
entities.summary: The hook blocks what it should and lets the rest through, init merges safely and idempotently, and report aggregates the log.
criteria: grep, rg in a pipeline, git grep, find, cat on a file, sed -n on a file, xargs grep and the Grep and Glob tools are blocked
dotnet build, git log, a heredoc to a file, echo grep, sed -i, tail -f, find -exec, # allow-raw commands and other tools are allowed
the built-in Read is blocked for .cs files in any letter case and allowed for other files or no path, and its message names zazzle read
blocked commands point at zazzle_find, zazzle_ls and zazzle_read, and C# declarations at zazzle_find_symbol, never at the indexer's removed tools

init merges into existing settings, is idempotent and keeps unrelated keys; it registers the zazzle server, its permission and enabled server, and the Bash|Grep|Glob|Read matcher, and removes the indexer's server, permission and enabled server left by an earlier init
without daemon, init writes no MCP server at all and says daemon was not found
daemon beside the indexer is found, and a directory that does not exist is never returned (the PATH lookup itself is not checked)
report aggregates tools, resolution paths, hook blocks and gap notes, also from records of tools since removed, and leaves out search selectivity and run commands

entities.title: uninit
entities.summary: uninit takes out exactly what init wrote, keeps every other byte, deletes only what is left empty, and is safe to repeat; JsonText cuts items cleanly.
criteria: a property or array element is cut with its comma and its whitespace, first, middle, last or only, nested, with escaped names, and nothing is returned for a path that is not there
after init on an empty project, uninit deletes .mcp.json, .claude/settings.json and .claude/, and a second run finds nothing to undo
in hand-written files, only init's server, hook entry, permission and enabled server go (and the containers they leave empty); layout, other hooks and other keys stay byte for byte
a redirect hook sharing its entry with another hook is removed alone
a zazzle server with extra keys is kept with a note, and a file that is not JSON is left unchanged
--dry-run lists the changes and writes nothing
the command line takes a folder, defaults to the current one and refuses two folders
